guard: a Claude app conversation's identity opens only under a name not live on the mesh and not on a per-user sign-in mesh, from the mesh's default persona, with its credential in an owner-only file and never on stdout; retire removes only what provision made, its broker footprint before its files; and the next provision retires what a host that died left behind
why: The smoke runs the command in-process from source against a live JWT-auth broker, so each mutation needs no build.
Each retire guard conjunct has its own cell: a directory of another name under the temp dir, a credential-named directory elsewhere, and a credential-named link.
The sweep has a cell each way: an orphan whose owner pid is dead goes, a directory whose owner is alive stays.

mutations.name: provision ignores a live name
mutations.find: if (taken.has(name)) return { ok: false, taken: true };
mutations.expectRed: a second provision of a live name answers taken
mutations.cell: a second provision of a live name answers taken
mutations.note: D1: a live name is answered as taken, never opened a second time.

mutations.name: provision forgets an unanswering mesh
mutations.find: if (!taken) return { ok: false, error: `the mesh "${t.space}" at ${t.server} is not answering. Start it with \`cotal up\`.` };
mutations.expectRed: a mesh that is not answering is refused by name
mutations.cell: a mesh that is not answering is refused by name
mutations.note: A mesh that does not answer is refused in a sentence that names it.

mutations.name: provision opens on a per-user sign-in mesh
mutations.expectRed: a mesh that uses per-user sign-in is refused by name
mutations.cell: a mesh that uses per-user sign-in is refused by name
mutations.note: A mesh that uses per-user sign-in is refused before anything dials it.

mutations.name: provision loses the missing-persona sentence
mutations.expectRed: a mesh with no default persona is refused, naming where it looked
mutations.cell: a mesh with no default persona is refused, naming where it looked
mutations.note: A missing default persona is refused with where it looked and what to run.

mutations.name: provision drops the persona's channels
mutations.expectRed: the env carries the default persona's channels and role
mutations.cell: the env carries the default persona's channels and role
mutations.note: The conversation's read and post sets come from the default persona.

mutations.name: provision writes a world-readable credential
mutations.note: The credential file is readable by its owner only.

mutations.name: retire removes a directory anywhere
mutations.expectRed: retire refuses a credential-named directory outside the temp directory
mutations.cell: retire refuses a credential-named directory outside the temp directory
mutations.note: Retire removes only a directory directly under the OS temp dir.

mutations.name: retire removes a directory of any name
mutations.expectRed: retire refuses a directory provision did not make
mutations.cell: retire refuses a directory provision did not make
mutations.note: Retire removes only a directory with provision's prefix.

mutations.name: retire follows a link
mutations.expectRed: retire refuses a credential-named link to another directory
mutations.cell: retire refuses a credential-named link to another directory
mutations.note: Retire refuses a link, so a credential-named link cannot point it at another directory's file.

mutations.name: retire leaves the credential directory
mutations.note: Retire removes the credential, the record and the directory.

mutations.name: retire leaves the broker footprint
mutations.find: await deprovisionAgent({ servers: t.server, space: t.space, targetId: record.id, lifecycleUid: record.lifecycleUid, creds });
mutations.note: Retire removes the identity's read-ACL row and both durables.

mutations.name: retire drops the credential before the footprint
mutations.replace:
rmSync(join(dir, "agent.creds"), { force: true });
  const t = target(record.space);
mutations.expectRed: and keeps what a later retire needs
mutations.cell: and keeps what a later retire needs
mutations.note: A retire that cannot reach the broker keeps the files, so a later attempt still knows what to retire.

mutations.name: provision sweeps no orphans
mutations.expectRed: and retired the identity whose host is gone
mutations.cell: and retired the identity whose host is gone
mutations.note: A provision retires what a host that died without retiring left behind.

mutations.name: the sweep retires live hosts' identities
mutations.expectRed: and kept the one whose host is alive
mutations.cell: and kept the one whose host is alive
mutations.note: The sweep keeps every directory whose owning process is alive.

mutations.name: the sweep keeps the dead host's identity
mutations.expectRed: and retired the identity whose host is gone
mutations.cell: and retired the identity whose host is gone
mutations.note: The sweep retires a directory whose owning process is gone.

mutations.name: provision records no owner
mutations.find: const record: IdentityRecord = { space: t.space, id: identity.id, lifecycleUid, owner: process.ppid };
mutations.replace: const record: IdentityRecord = { space: t.space, id: identity.id, lifecycleUid, owner: process.pid };
mutations.expectRed: a record beside it names the identity, its mesh and the process that asked
mutations.cell: a record beside it names the identity, its mesh and the process that asked
mutations.note: The record names the process that ran provision, the host whose death makes the identity an orphan.
